_instructions: Source of truth for the build. DO NOT delete, edit, or renumber existing ids/titles. Statuses: passing (done+proven), failing (actionable), deferred (postponed; notes say when actionable), superseded (dead, kept for history). Flip failing->passing only when a test or the stated manual check proves it. Append new features with the next id in their milestone. Work ONE feature per session: lowest milestone, then lowest id, among 'failing'.

features.title: Release README coverage: every CHANGELOG release from 3.17.0 names the README phrases that document it (or README: none (reason)), checked by scripts/check-readme.sh in the gate; HARNESS_TEMPLATE_DIR runs the template sync check
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-check-readme.sh proving a covered release passes, and a missing README: line, a line without phrases, none without a reason, a phrase absent from README.md and 3.17.10 (numeric compare) all fail; this repo's CHANGELOG/README pass; bash scripts/ci-local.sh prints CI-LOCAL GREEN
